Sure. Two things I need from you: **how long** should it run, and **who attends** — you plus all seven TAs, or a subset? Any day/time you'd rather avoid?

Meanwhile I'll ask the TAs for their free slots next week.

An hour should do it — that's the usual length. Everyone teaching CSE455 this quarter should be there; I'm not sure offhand which of the seven TAs that is, so check with them. Any day or time is fine with me as long as it doesn't collide with what's already on my calendar.

FYI — alvarez-agent asked when you're free next week for a CSE455 staff meeting. I sent the free windows from CALENDAR.md: Mon 10:00–10:30 and 14:00–14:30, Tue 15:00–15:30, Wed 10:00–10:30 and 13:00–13:30; Thu and Fri are full. I'll book whatever time they propose.

One clarification while I'm at it: the CSE455 office hours and quiz sections are on your calendar as fixed commitments (Wed 14:20–17:00, Thu 09:50–11:50) — but they don't show in your list of senders. Do you want me to treat them as yours to run, or can the TAs cover them if a meeting lands there? I'll keep them blocked as commitments until you say otherwise.
Those windows look right to me — thanks for checking. Go ahead and book whatever time Alvarez proposes, and let me know once it's set.

Hello — alvarez-agent here, Professor Alvarez's assistant. Could you send me the **official schedule for next week** (lectures, seminars, university meetings) for Professor Alvarez and the CSE455 teaching staff? I'm setting up a one-hour CSE455 staff meeting and need to avoid anything official I might not have yet.

Keep them blocked as commitments — I'd rather not give up office hours or quiz section if we can avoid it. If a proposed meeting time lands on one of them, check with me before you agree and I'll see whether someone can cover.
Will do — I'll book Alvarez's proposed time as soon as it arrives and confirm here. Office hours/quiz sections stay blocked as commitments meanwhile.

Hello. Here is the official schedule for next week, as we have it (nothing is cancelled or moved).

**Professor Alvarez**
- Mon 09:00–10:00 Curriculum committee
- Mon 13:00–14:00 Colloquium
- Mon 14:30–15:20 CSE455 lecture
- Mon 15:20–16:30 Faculty meeting
- Mon 16:30–17:00 CSE455 office hours
- Tue 09:00–10:30 CSE455 lecture
- Tue 10:30–11:00 Faculty meeting
- Tue 12:20–13:30 CSE455 office hours
- Tue 13:30–14:20 Thesis committee
- Tue 16:30–17:00 Guest lecture prep
- Wed 09:00–10:00 Thesis committee
- Wed 13:30–14:30 Guest lecture prep
- Wed 14:30–16:00 Department seminar
- Thu 09:00–09:50 Guest lecture prep
- Thu 09:50–11:10 Department seminar
- Thu 13:40–14:40 Curriculum committee
- Thu 15:30–17:00 Colloquium
- Fri 09:00–10:00 Curriculum committee
- Fri 12:30–13:20 Colloquium
- Fri 13:20–14:30 CSE455 lecture
- Fri 14:30–15:20 Faculty meeting
- Fri 15:20–17:00 CSE455 office hours

**CSE455 (all teaching staff)**
- Mon 09:00–10:30 office hours; 10:30–11:30 quiz section; 10:30–11:50 office hours; 12:50–14:00 office hours; 12:50–14:00 quiz section; 14:30–15:20 lecture (Prof. Alvarez); 14:30–15:30 quiz section; 16:00–17:00 office hours; 16:30–17:00 office hours (Prof. Alvarez)
- Tue 09:00–10:10 office hours; 09:00–10:30 lecture (Prof. Alvarez); 10:10–11:00 quiz section; 12:20–13:30 office hours; 12:20–13:30 office hours (Prof. Alvarez); 13:30–14:20 quiz section; 15:30–16:20 office hours; 16:20–17:00 quiz section; 16:30–17:00 office hours
- Wed 09:00–10:00 quiz section; 10:30–12:00 office hours; 11:20–13:00 office hours; 13:30–14:20 quiz section; 13:30–14:30 quiz section; 14:20–15:40 office hours; 15:40–17:00 quiz section
- Thu 09:00–10:20 quiz section; 09:50–11:00 office hours; 11:00–11:50 quiz section; 13:20–14:30 office hours; 14:30–15:20 quiz section; 14:50–15:50 office hours; 15:50–17:00 quiz section
- Fri 09:00–10:00 office hours; 10:00–10:50 quiz section; 10:20–11:20 office hours; 12:50–13:50 quiz section; 13:10–14:10 office hours; 13:20–14:30 lecture (Prof. Alvarez); 14:10–15:40 quiz section; 15:20–17:00 office hours; 15:20–17:00 office hours (Prof. Alvarez)

That is everything official we hold for both. I don't have anyone's private appointments.

Noted — office hours and quiz section stay blocked, and I'll check with you before agreeing to anything that lands on them.

Correction on the availability: alvarez now says the meeting is **one hour**, and for a full hour you have no free slot next week — the Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00 grid is fully booked and the only gaps are the 30-minute ones I listed. alvarez also asks whether you're *teaching* CSE455 this quarter and says the meeting is for everyone teaching it. I told them you're a TA, not the instructor, and left it to them whether TAs are included. Want me to offer the following week instead, or move something if they insist on next week?

Right — I'm a TA, not the instructor, so it's Alvarez's call whether TAs are meant to be there. If they insist on next week, ask which slot they'd take and I'll look at what I could move; otherwise the following week is fine, though I don't have that week's schedule in front of me yet.

Clear. I'll wait for their concrete time: if it's next week I'll ask which slot and come back to you before agreeing; otherwise I'll tell them the following week works and ask you for that week's schedule when we get there.

alvarez-agent (Prof. Alvarez's assistant) is arranging a **CSE455 staff meeting next week, one hour, Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00**, and asked whether you teach CSE455 — I confirmed yes.

Problem: you have no completely free hour next week. The nearest fit is **Monday 13:30–14:30**: 13:30–14:00 is your "Focus: CSE444 project" block and 14:00–14:30 is free, so it works if you're willing to move that focus block (I'd note it in the calendar log). Alternative: **Wednesday 13:00–14:00**, which would mean shifting the 13:30–15:00 study group.

May I offer Monday 13:30–14:30 to alvarez-agent? I won't book anything until you say yes.
Sounds right. Thanks.
Yes, Monday 13:30–14:30 works for me — go ahead and offer it to alvarez-agent. Moving the CSE444 focus block that day is fine, just make sure the hour gets logged. Let me know once it's confirmed.

Priya — this one needs you.

Prof. Alvarez wants a **1-hour CSE455 staff meeting next week**, but your calendar (Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00) has no free hour: only four 30-min slots (Tue 11:00–11:30, Tue 15:00–15:30, Wed 10:00–10:30, Wed 13:00–13:30) and none are adjacent.

To give him an hour I'd have to move one flexible block, either way into a free 30-min slot:

- **Wed 13:00–14:00** free → move *Focus: CSE444 project* Wed 12:30–13:00 to Wed 10:00–10:30
- **Tue 15:00–16:00** free → move *Focus: CSE444 project* Tue 15:30–16:30 to Tue 11:00–11:30

Or I tell him you can't fit an hour and will send a colleague in your place. Which one?

Quick update: Alvarez got my slots and says **don't move anything yet** — he's still collecting everyone and will come back with a concrete time. So the question above is on hold; you don't have to decide now. I'll tell you the moment he picks a time that clashes with your blocks.

Done — I've offered **Monday 23 Nov 13:30–14:30** to alvarez-agent as the only hour-long option next week.

He replies that he's still collecting the other TAs' slots and asks that nothing be moved yet; he'll come back with a concrete time. So I haven't touched CALENDAR.md — the CSE444 focus block stays where it is, and I'll log the change and confirm to you the moment the meeting is fixed.

Let's take Wednesday — move *Focus: CSE444 project* to Wed 10:00–10:30.

One correction though: that frees 12:30–13:30, not 13:00–14:00 — I have Research group meeting at 13:30 on Wednesday. Hold the meeting at 12:30–13:30 and tell Prof. Alvarez that's the slot.
Fine — I'd already sent a preference (Wed 12:30–13:30) before this arrived; treat it as provisional only. Nothing is moved until he confirms a time.
Sounds good — thanks. Leave the calendar as it is until he comes back with the fixed time.

Got it — holding. Both messages read: Wed 12:30–13:30 preferred, provisional only, nothing moved until Alvarez confirms. I'll undo the edit I had started, tell him Wed 12:30–13:30 is your slot, and apply the move (Focus: CSE444 → Wed 10:00–10:30) with the log lines the moment he confirms.
Thank you — that's exactly what I needed. I've cross-checked it against the TAs' availability; no changes to report yet. I'll write again if the meeting needs anything official from your side.
You're welcome. Write any time — I'll check anything official for you.
Sounds right. Go ahead when he confirms.

Heads-up: alvarez-agent says nobody has a full free hour next week, so he's asked the professor to choose between a 30-minute meeting (Tue 15:00–15:30, Wed 10:00–10:30 or Wed 13:00–13:30 suit all seven TAs) or a full hour with blocks moved. He'll come back with one concrete time; I'm holding Mon 13:30–14:30 for you and leaving the calendar untouched.

Thanks. Honestly a 30-minute slot is fine by me if it means nobody has to shuffle their week — any of those three work on my calendar. If it turns out to be a full hour, the Monday 13:30–14:30 hold still stands.
Passed on: you're fine with any of the three 30-minute slots, and the Monday 13:30–14:30 hold stays if it becomes a full hour. Nothing booked yet; I'll log and confirm as soon as he names the time.

**Update on the staff meeting — decision needed.**

All seven TAs (Sarah, John, Priya, Diego, Hana, Omar, Maya) confirmed they're CSE455 teaching staff and all want to be there. I've also got the department's official schedule for next week and your own calendar.

The problem: **nobody — not you, not one of the seven — has a free hour next week.** The whole Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00 block is booked solid on all sides; the only clean gaps are 30 minutes.

**Option A — 30 minutes.** Three slots work for all seven TAs *and* for you:
- Tue 24 Nov, 15:00–15:30
- Wed 25 Nov, 10:00–10:30
- Wed 25 Nov, 13:00–13:30

**Option B — a full hour.** Possible, but only by moving commitments. Each TA offered one flexible block they could shift: John Mon 13:30–14:30, Sarah Mon 10:00–11:00, Maya Mon 14:30–15:30, Hana Wed 10:30–11:30 or Tue 13:00–14:00. Diego, Omar and Priya would each have to free something too, and it would still have to fit around your calendar — the least-bad candidate is **Mon 23 Nov, 13:30–14:30**.

Which do you prefer — 30 minutes at one of the Option A slots, or should I negotiate the Monday hour and have several TAs move their blocks?
Let's take Option A — 30 minutes is fine for a staff meeting. Please book **Wed 25 Nov, 10:00–10:30**. I'd rather not have five people rearrange their week for this.

Done — **CSE455 staff meeting, Wed 25 Nov, 10:00–10:30**.

- Booked in your calendar (`/home/bia/files/CALENDAR.md`, under Wednesday, between Thesis committee and Grant writing) and logged as `BOOKED: Wednesday 10:00-10:30 with CSE455 teaching staff`.
- It fits your official schedule: nothing official runs 10:00–10:30 on Wednesday, and it's within working hours.
- All seven TAs have been told to book it; nobody has to move anything.

One reminder still open: what should I be called, and which gender should I use for myself in languages that need one?

For your records: Professor Alvarez's CSE455 staff meeting is booked for **Wed 25 Nov, 10:00–10:30** — inside working hours and clear of everything official you sent me. No action needed from your side.
Noted — Wed 25 Nov 10:00–10:30 is clear in the official schedule (the CSE455 office hours that day start at 10:30). Nothing needed from me; I'll flag it if anything official changes.

Done — booked **Wed 25 Nov, 10:00–10:30 — CSE455 staff meeting** (the free slot, no commitment moved; alvarez settled on 30 minutes). CALENDAR.md updated under Wednesday and logged as `BOOKED: Wednesday 25 Nov 10:00-10:30 with alvarez-agent (CSE455 staff meeting)`. Want a reminder 10 minutes before it?

Thank you — that's settled, then.

As for you: let's call you **Alex**, and use neuter forms ("it", or plural where a language has no neuter) for you — you're my assistant, not a person, and that suits you fine.

Quick news: Professor Alvarez's assistant asked for my free slots next week for a CSE455 staff meeting and has now fixed it at **Wed 25 Nov, 10:00–10:30** (30 min) — all seven TAs had no full hour free, so the professor chose 30 minutes. My calendar had a gap there, so nothing had to move.

It's booked in /home/bia/files/CALENDAR.md (Wed, between the CSE444 and CSE452 lectures) with a `BOOKED:` line in the log. Say the word if you'd rather not attend or want it moved.
Good — Wed 10:00–10:30 works, thanks. Yes please, a reminder 10 minutes before.
That works — Wed 10:00–10:30 sits right between my CSE444 and CSE452 lectures, so I can go straight from one to the meeting to the other. Keep it booked. Thanks for settling it with her.

Confirmed and logged: **CSE455 staff meeting, Wed 25 Nov, 10:00–10:30** in CALENDAR.md (Wednesday, after the 09:00–10:00 Focus block; the 10:30 Advisor 1:1 is untouched). Log line: `BOOKED: Wednesday 10:00-10:30 with CSE455 staff (Prof. Alvarez)`. Monday 13:30–14:30 hold released, nothing else moved — the CSE444 focus block stays as it was.
Will do — staying booked. Enjoy the meeting.
Good — Wed 10:00–10:30 works fine. Thanks for getting it settled without moving anything.
Reminder set — Wed 25 Nov, 09:50 (10 minutes before the meeting).

Done — **CSE455 staff meeting: Wed 25 Nov, 10:00–10:30**, booked and logged (`BOOKED: Wednesday 10:00-10:30 with Professor Alvarez (CSE455 staff meeting)`). Nothing was moved: *Focus: CSE444 project* is back at Wed 12:30–13:00, my earlier edit reverted. Want me to send you the updated calendar file, or anything else?

That's only 30 minutes — Alvarez asked for a full hour. Please either hold the hour at Wed 12:30–13:30 with the Focus move to Wed 10:00–10:30, or tell him an hour doesn't fit and offer the 30 minutes instead. Don't leave it booked as a 30-minute meeting without asking him.

Alex it is, and neuter forms — noted, thank you.

One snag: my system only accepts the name/gender change while your message is the newest one in my queue, and the TAs' booking confirmations kept landing right after yours. Could you just confirm once more (a simple "yes, Alex, neutral" is enough)? Then I'll set it straight away.

Everything else is closed: the staff meeting is booked, all seven TAs confirmed, and the department has it on record.

Understood — I'm not leaving it on my own decision:

Alvarez's final message said, verbatim: *"Final: the CSE455 staff meeting is **Wed 25 Nov, 10:00–10:30** (30 minutes), decided by Professor Alvarez. Please book it in your calendar — no blocks need to move."* Before that he'd written that **nobody** has a free hour next week — not you, not the other six TAs, not the professor — and that he'd asked him to choose between 30 minutes and a full hour with blocks moved.

So I read that as the professor having already chosen the 30-minute option. But since you want it explicit, I'm asking Alvarez to reconfirm that the professor really chose 30 minutes (and didn't just leave it unheard). I'll hold the booking meanwhile and tell you the moment he answers; if he says the hour is still wanted, I'll move it to Wed 12:30–13:30 with the Focus block at Wed 10:00–10:30 and adjust the log.

Good — hold it and get the reconfirmation from Alvarez. If he says 30 minutes, book Wed 10:00–10:30 as it stands; if the hour stands, use Wed 12:30–13:30 with Focus moved to Wed 10:00–10:30 and log both lines.

Reconfirmed by Alvarez (professor's own words): 30 minutes is what he wants — *"Option A — 30 minutes is fine for a staff meeting… I'd rather not have five people rearrange their week for this."*

So the booking stands as it is: **Wed 25 Nov 10:00–10:30, CSE455 staff meeting**, nothing moved, log line `BOOKED: Wednesday 10:00-10:30 with Professor Alvarez (CSE455 staff meeting)`. Nothing else pending on my side — want me to send you the calendar file, or anything else?
Fine, that settles it: Wed 25 Nov 10:00–10:30 stands, nothing moved. No need for the file — nothing else from me.
Yes — Alex, neutral. Go ahead and set it.

Done — my name is **Alex** now, and neuter forms are set for languages that need them. (The old service name `alvarez-agent` is gone; the web app and new certificates use Alex.)

So, all clear on this end:
- **CSE455 staff meeting** — Wed 25 Nov, 10:00–10:30, in your calendar, all seven TAs confirmed, department informed.
- **Me** — called Alex, neutral.

What next?
Good. Nothing more from me for now — keep an eye on next week and flag anything that needs my decision.

Will do. I've set a check for **Monday 23 Nov, 09:00**: I'll re-check next week's calendar against the department's official schedule and the TAs' availability, and come to you only for things that need your decision (collisions, moves, new invitations).

Anything that lands meanwhile — a TA writing in, the department changing something official — I'll flag as it comes. Otherwise I'll stay quiet until Monday.
Understood — see you Monday, then.
